# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- When modifying this project, add XML documentation comments for classes and methods, and add inline comments only where they clarify non-obvious logic.
- Servo is Australian slang for a petrol station (service station).
- This solution contains three projects: the Windows desktop project VicServoPriceWatch, the shared VicServoPriceWatch.Core library, and the .NET MAUI Android project VicServoPriceWatch.Android. The MAUI project is only one part of the solution.

## API Management
- For the Android version, enter and manage the API key through the app's settings rather than bundling it in configuration.
